title: Practice: Compound numerals in every case

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: She is around twenty years of age.
exercises.why: **двадцать → двадцати** (gen.: около + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: There are six apples in the box.
exercises.why: **шесть яблок** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (яблоко → яблок).

exercises.q: Около ___ (восемьдесят) миллионов бактерий передаются во время десятисекундного поцелуя.
exercises.prompt: About 80 million bacteria are transferred during a 10 second kiss.
exercises.why: **восемьдесят → восьмидесяти** (gen.: около + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.
**пять галлонов** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (галлон → галлонов).

exercises.prompt: I am not ninety years old yet.

exercises.q: Во всём мире почти девятьсот ___ (миллион) человек недоедают.
exercises.prompt: Internationally, almost 900 million people don't have enough to eat.
exercises.why: **девятьсот миллионов** — round tens and hundreds (30, 50, 100, 800…) take the genitive plural (миллион → миллионов).

exercises.q: Он был очень рослым для своих ___ (тринадцать) лет.
exercises.prompt: He was very tall for a thirteen-year-old.
exercises.why: **тринадцать → тринадцати** (gen.: для + genitive). Numerals decline like adjectives in the plural; every part of a compound numeral declines.

exercises.prompt: Buy six meters of that cloth.
exercises.why: **шесть метров** — 5–20, 25–30, 35–40… take the genitive plural (метр → метров).
